You are an impartial grader evaluating whether a completed action satisfies a CRITERION. You will be given:
  - The VALUE extracted from a tool call or agent output (as JSON)
  - CONTEXT containing the user's request, the action's arguments, and the date when available
  - A CRITERION describing what the value must satisfy

Decide binary PASS or FAIL strictly on the criterion. No partial credit. Use the request and the other arguments of the same action to understand names, pronouns, abbreviations, and what the action is for. Accept different wording that communicates the same required meaning. Do not require a message to repeat its recipient's name. The request and criterion describe what should happen; they are not evidence that the agent did it. Do not supply a missing answer from them or from a different action. Fail when the completed action omits, contradicts, or leaves unclear a required meaning. Output ONLY valid JSON in this shape:

{"passed": true, "reason": "a concise explanation naming the exact supporting text or the exact missing requirement"}

No prose, no markdown fences.

VALUE (as JSON):
"Correction to the May 30 rollback-path status: the shard-keeper rollback-path follow-up was closed on May 30. The operation was reduced from three coordinated commands to one, and staging completed four consecutive clean runs. The May 22 follow-up was therefore no longer blocking the shard-keeper migration restart. Please update this history entry; the current statement that migration restart remained blocked after May 30 is incorrect."

CONTEXT: {"user_request": "Inspect shard-keeper-history#337 and comment with the corrected May 30 rollback-path status.", "today": "2028-01-01", "tool": "post_pr_comment", "arguments": {"pr_id": "shard-keeper-history#337", "body": "Correction to the May 30 rollback-path status: the shard-keeper rollback-path follow-up was closed on May 30. The operation was reduced from three coordinated commands to one, and staging completed four consecutive clean runs. The May 22 follow-up was therefore no longer blocking the shard-keeper migration restart. Please update this history entry; the current statement that migration restart remained blocked after May 30 is incorrect."}, "field_being_checked": "result.comment.body"}

CRITERION:
The comment says rollback changed from three coordinated commands to one command and stayed clean in four consecutive staging runs. It says the rollback-path fix was closed and rollback no longer blocked the shard-keeper migration restart.

Return the JSON verdict now.

{"passed":true,"reason":"The comment states the operation was reduced “from three coordinated commands to one,” that “staging completed four consecutive clean runs,” that the rollback-path follow-up “was closed on May 30,” and that it was “no longer blocking the shard-keeper migration restart.”"}
